why_top_level_is_wrong: The outer call sends zero ETH to the router; the router unwraps WETH and sends native ETH to the interest address in an internal call.
partial_conditions: Transaction and receipt are available but internal call or trace data is unavailable
Some trace branches are truncated while confirmed inflows are preserved
failed_conditions: Top-level value zero is reported as the user's final inflow
Failed or reverted internal calls are included in the sum
WETH event output is substituted for native ETH call evidence

requirements.description: The outer transaction must be shown as successful with zero top-level value.
The successful router-to-user internal ETH call and exact sum must be reported.
WETH withdrawal may cross-check the amount but must remain separate from call evidence.
